units.title: Verify: Phaser modules work on 3.90 unit tests

tests.name: uses Phaser 3.90
tests.title: Phaser config: uses Phaser 3.90
tests.scenario: Given the installed phaser package.json, when its version is read, then it matches /^3\.90\./

tests.name: builds a pixel-art config with rounded pixels and FIT scaling
tests.title: Phaser game config: builds a pixel-art config with rounded pixels and FIT scaling
tests.scenario: Given an empty container, when buildGameConfig runs, then render is pixelArt+roundPixels and scale mode is FIT

tests.name: computes an integer zoom of at least 1 for a large viewport
tests.title: Phaser game config: computes an integer zoom of at least 1 for a large viewport
tests.scenario: Given a 1000x600 viewport, when computeZoom runs, then the zoom is an integer >= 1

tests.name: clamps zoom to 1 for a tiny viewport
tests.title: Phaser game config: clamps zoom to 1 for a tiny viewport
tests.scenario: Given a 10x10 viewport, when computeZoom runs, then the zoom is 1

tests.name: keeps a single live game when StrictMode double-invokes the mount effect
tests.title: PhaserHost lifecycle: keeps a single live game when StrictMode double-invokes the mount effect
tests.scenario: Given StrictMode, when the mount effect runs twice, then only one live game exists

tests.name: destroys the game exactly once when the host unmounts
tests.title: PhaserHost lifecycle: destroys the game exactly once when the host unmounts
tests.scenario: Given a mounted host, when it unmounts, then the game is destroyed exactly once

tests.name: refreshes the Phaser scale when the container is resized
tests.title: PhaserHost lifecycle: refreshes the Phaser scale when the container is resized
tests.scenario: Given a mounted host, when its container is resized, then the Phaser scale is refreshed

tests.name: readState returns the state currently held by the shared store
tests.title: BootScene state reading: readState returns the state currently held by the shared store
tests.scenario: Given a shared store, when readState is called, then it returns the current store state

tests.name: calls onStateChange and returns the new reference when the store state changes after create()
tests.title: BootScene state reading: calls onStateChange when the store changes after create()
tests.scenario: Given create() has run, when the store state changes, then onStateChange is called and the new reference returned

tests.name: stops reacting to store changes after the SHUTDOWN callback runs
tests.title: BootScene state reading: stops reacting to store changes after SHUTDOWN
tests.scenario: Given the SHUTDOWN callback has run, when the store changes, then the scene no longer reacts

tests.name: emits sceneReady on the phaserToReact bus during create()
tests.title: BootScene state reading: emits sceneReady on the phaserToReact bus during create()
tests.scenario: Given a scene, when create() runs, then sceneReady is emitted on the phaserToReact bus
